1.titleEnglish: Awake, my soul, and with the sun
1.lyricsEnglish:
Awake, my soul, and with the sun
Thy daily stage of duty run;
Shake off dull sloth, and joyful rise
To pay thy morning sacrifice.

Redeem thy mis-spent time that's past,
Live this day as if 'twere thy last;
Improve thy talent with due care;
For the great day thyself prepare.

Let all thy converse be sincere,
Thy conscience as the noon-day clear;
Think how all-seeing God thy ways
And all thy secret thoughts surveys.

By influence of the light divine
Let thy own light to others shine;
Reflect all heaven's propitious rays
In ardent love and cheerful praise.

Wake, and lift up thyself, my heart,
And with the angels bear thy part,
Who all night long unwearied sing
High praise to the eternal King.

Lord, I my vows to Thee renew;
Disperse my sins as morning dew;
Guard my first springs of thought and will,
And with Thyself my spirit fill.

3.titleEnglish: As morning breaks upon this day
3.lyricsEnglish:
As morning breaks upon this day,
And we arise, we come to pray;
Our hearts, O Lord, we lift to Thee:
Keep us and guard us through this day.

Help us to keep our lips from strife,
From angry words and bitter life;
Watch over us, and turn Thine eyes
From every thing that is not right.

Make clean our spirits, Lord, we pray,
And keep them gentle all the day;
Our feeble bodies, worn and weak,
Give them the bread of life to eat.

And all that we shall do today
Let it bring glory to our God;
And when the evening hour shall come,
Let us not fear the dark at all.

All glory be for ever Thine,
Our Father, and the Son divine,
And Thee, the Holy Spirit blest,
Who reignest over every age.

4.titleEnglish: Forth in Thy name, O Lord, I go
4.lyricsEnglish:
Forth in Thy name, O Lord, I go,
My daily labour to pursue,
Thee, only Thee, resolved to know
In all I think, or speak, or do.

The task Thy wisdom hath assigned
O let me cheerfully fulfil,
In all my works Thy presence find,
And prove Thy good and perfect will.

Thee may I set at my right hand,
Whose eyes mine inmost substance see,
And labour on at Thy command,
And offer all my works to Thee.

Give me to bear Thy easy yoke,
And every moment watch and pray,
And still to things eternal look,
And hasten to Thy glorious day.

6.titleEnglish: When you awaken in the morning
6.lyricsEnglish:
When you awaken in the morning,
Before you start the work of day,
First read the book that Jesus wrote,
And kneel before the living God.
He will bestow His blessing on you
When you have told Him everything.

Whether joy or sorrow meets you
Wherever you may be today,
Let nothing find you unprepared;
Be ready when the hour shall come.
Do not fear the devil's power;
You shall overcome the foe,
And you shall strike him down,
When you put your trust in Jesus.

The words of God will feed your soul
As you remember them, and so
You come to see His lasting peace.
In prayer you will receive
Wisdom and strength to drive away
The enemies who attack you.

Weariness and weakness too,
And every burden that you bear,
And all the snares the devil lays,
You shall be able to withstand.
Ask Jesus to stay close to you
Whenever sorrow meets your day;
So you will find the strength you need
When you have told Him everything.

7.titleEnglish: Awake, my soul, the dawn is here

9.titleEnglish: To You, O Jesus, we offer
9.lyricsEnglish:
To You, O Jesus, we offer
This day that is Your own;
You alone know all things well.
Keep us from wasting it,
And give us all Your blessings.

If the day should bring us joy,
Come, our Helper, be our stay;
Let us not be caught at all
In the snares of the deceiver.
We are but feeble, Lord;
Drive the enemy away.

This only do we long for:
To be found pleasing to Jesus.
When He shall come again
To call us on that day,
May He find every one of us
Watching and waiting for Him.

10.lyricsEnglish:
Hear me, our Father,
You who keep me safe;
Stay close beside me,
And heal me, Lord.

O Lord Jesus,
Who gives us life,
Let me run the race
Until I come to You.

You are our Helper,
Spirit of God;
See how I need You:
Draw me near, and cleanse me.

Come, O God,
And dwell right here;
From this hour
Make Your home within me.

12.titleEnglish: Sun of my soul, Thou Saviour dear
12.lyricsEnglish:
Sun of my soul, Thou Saviour dear,
It is not night if Thou be near;
O may no earth-born cloud arise
To hide Thee from Thy servant's eyes.

When the soft dews of kindly sleep
My wearied eyelids gently steep,
Be my last thought, how sweet to rest
For ever on my Saviour's breast.

Abide with me from morn till eve,
For without Thee I cannot live;
Abide with me when night is nigh,
For without Thee I dare not die.

Come near and bless me when I wake,
Ere through the world my way I take,
Till in the ocean of Thy love
I lose myself in heaven above.

13.lyricsEnglish:
Beautiful light, You dwell
With our Father on high;
Glorious One, our shield,
You died for sinners' sake.
Saviour Jesus,
We are glad to see You.

Before the day is ended,
And darkness gathers in,
With songs of eventide
We praise our Father,
And Jesus, His Son,
And the Holy Spirit.

You who are holy,
We give You praise.
Jesus, our life,
On earth and in heaven;
Let the earth that praises You
Never cease Your praise.

14.titleEnglish: Now every creature takes its rest
14.lyricsEnglish:
Now every creature takes its rest,
The beasts and all the flowers,
And people fall asleep.
Sleep has taken hold of them,
But you, my soul, consider this.

The heavens shine
When the hour grows late,
And the stars come out.
When God shall call me,
I will go quickly to Him
And leave this weariness.

All our members are glad
To rest when work is done.
So too, my soul,
When at last it is laid down,
Shall be filled with peace.

When we sleep, our eyes
Are closed, and we hear nothing;
But Jesus keeps
All who put their trust in Him,
And those who hide themselves in Him.

15.lyricsEnglish:
Now the day is over,
Night is drawing nigh,
Shadows of the evening
Steal across the sky.

Now the darkness gathers,
Stars begin to peep,
Birds and beasts and flowers
Soon will be asleep.

Jesus, give the weary
Calm and sweet repose;
With Thy tenderest blessing
May mine eyelids close.

Grant to little children
Visions bright of Thee;
Guard the sailors tossing
On the deep blue sea.

Glory to the Father,
Glory to the Son,
And to Thee, blest Spirit,
Whilst all ages run.

16.titleEnglish: The day is past and over
16.lyricsEnglish:
The day is past and over:
All thanks, O Lord, to Thee;
I pray Thee that offenceless
The hours of dark may be.
O Jesus, keep me in Thy sight,
And save me through the coming night.

The joys of day are over:
I lift my heart to Thee,
And call on Thee that sinless
The hours of dark may be.
O Jesus, make their darkness light,
And save me through the coming night.

The toils of day are over:
I raise the hymn to Thee,
And ask that free from peril
The hours of dark may be.
O Jesus, keep me in Thy sight,
And guard me through the coming night.

17.titleEnglish: Before the ending of the day
17.lyricsEnglish:
Before the ending of the day,
Creator of the world, we pray
That with Thy wonted favour Thou
Wouldst be our Guard and Keeper now.

From all ill dreams defend our eyes,
From nightly fears and fantasies;
Tread under foot our ghostly foe,
That no pollution we may know.

O Father, that we ask be done,
Through Jesus Christ, Thine only Son;
Who, with the Holy Ghost and Thee,
Doth live and reign eternally.

19.titleEnglish: Saviour, again to Thy dear name we raise

20.titleEnglish: The day Thou gavest, Lord, is ended
20.lyricsEnglish:
The day Thou gavest, Lord, is ended,
The darkness falls at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns ascended,
Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.

We thank Thee that Thy Church, unsleeping,
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is keeping,
And rests not now by day or night.

As o'er each continent and island
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of prayer is never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise away.

So be it, Lord; Thy throne shall never,
Like earth's proud empires, pass away;
Thy kingdom stands, and grows for ever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

22.titleEnglish: Our Father, Maker of all things
22.lyricsEnglish:
Our Father, Maker of all things,
Your creatures worship You;
For Jesus' sake, Your only Son,
Keep us through this night.

O Son, Redeemer of our souls,
Who set us free from bondage,
Guard our spirits, Lord, we pray,
That we may rest in peace in You.

O Spirit of power and might,
Who sanctifies the Church,
Come in the night of this day
And cleanse our hearts within.

All glory be for ever Thine,
Our Father and the Son,
And You, the Holy Spirit,
Who reigns through every age.

23.lyricsEnglish:
My God, I thank You
For all the good of this day,
And I ask You to keep me
Through all the hours of night.

Forgive the sins
That I have done today;
Give peace within my spirit
As I go to sleep.

Teach me every day
The path that I should take,
So that until I die
I may fear nothing at all.

Let me rest before Your face;
In the darkness I commit myself,
And rise again at morning
To serve You once more.

24.titleEnglish: May the grace of Christ our Saviour
24.lyricsEnglish:
May the grace of Christ our Saviour,
And the Father's boundless love,
With the Holy Spirit's favour,
Rest upon us from above.
Thus may we abide in union
With each other and the Lord,
And possess, in sweet communion,
Joys which earth cannot afford.

25.lyricsEnglish:
Our Father, we commit
Our bodies to Your care;
Keep us through the night in sleep
Until the break of day.

And we give You thanks
For Your word of promise,
The word You gave us all:
You will not forsake us.

26.lyricsEnglish:
O come, O come, Emmanuel,
And ransom captive Israel,
That mourns in lonely exile here,
Until the Son of God appear.
Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel.

O come, Thou Rod of Jesse, free
Thine own from Satan's tyranny;
From depths of hell Thy people save,
And give them victory o'er the grave.
Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel.

O come, Thou Dayspring, come and cheer
Our spirits by Thine advent here;
Disperse the gloomy clouds of night,
And death's dark shadows put to flight.
Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel.

O come, Thou Key of David, come,
And open wide our heavenly home;
Make safe the way that leads on high,
And close the path to misery.
Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel.

27.titleEnglish: Wake, awake, for night is flying

28.titleEnglish: Lo! He comes with clouds descending
28.lyricsEnglish:
Lo! He comes with clouds descending,
Once for favoured sinners slain;
Thousand thousand saints attending
Swell the triumph of His train:
Alleluia!
God appears on earth to reign.

Every eye shall now behold Him
Robed in dreadful majesty;
Those who set at nought and sold Him,
Pierced and nailed Him to the tree,
Deeply wailing,
Shall the true Messiah see.

Those dear tokens of His passion
Still His dazzling body bears,
Cause of endless exultation
To His ransomed worshippers:
With what rapture
Gaze we on those glorious scars!

Yea, Amen, let all adore Thee,
High on Thine eternal throne;
Saviour, take the power and glory,
Claim the kingdom for Thine own:
Alleluia!
Thou shalt reign, and Thou alone.

29.lyricsEnglish:
Rejoice, you chosen people
Who put your trust in Jesus;
Let your lamps be burning,
For the hour is late.
Our Lord is coming,
Even now He is near;
Rise up and keep watch,
And do not fall asleep.

Trim your lamps
To shine in the darkness,
And see the salvation
That has drawn near to you.
The Lord is in sight,
Even now He is near;
Go out with singing
To meet Him on the way.

Wise virgins,
Sing with all your heart
The songs of glory
That the angels sing.
Jesus waits for us,
The Saviour of the world;
You who are saved by Jesus,
Draw near, every one.

We believe in You, Jesus,
Our Saviour and our Lord;
Come quickly, come and take
Your kingdom as Your own.
May God be with us
To proclaim it everywhere,
Until all are saved.

30.titleEnglish: The night is past, the day has dawned
30.lyricsEnglish:
The night is past,
The day has dawned;
So let us cast away
The works of darkness.

Let us put on the truth
As armour for the fight;
Let us walk adorned,
And filled with joy.

All our sins,
The pleasures of the world,
And feasts of drunkenness,
Let us put them all away.

31.lyricsEnglish:
Come, Thou long-expected Jesus,
Born to set Thy people free;
From our fears and sins release us,
Let us find our rest in Thee.
Israel's strength and consolation,
Hope of all the earth Thou art;
Dear desire of every nation,
Joy of every longing heart.

Born Thy people to deliver,
Born a child and yet a King,
Born to reign in us forever,
Now Thy gracious kingdom bring.
By Thine own eternal Spirit
Rule in all our hearts alone;
By Thine all sufficient merit,
Raise us to Thy glorious throne.

32.titleEnglish: Our Saviour told us He would come
32.lyricsEnglish:
Our Saviour told us He would come
Again to earth: be ready.
We do not know the day He comes,
But we hope, and we wait.

And the hope that He has given
Will cheer us through every sorrow.
Those we love may leave us,
But that hope will make us strong.

Those who serve Him in this world
Shall receive their reward before Him,
And they shall receive His blessing
When their labour here is done.

On the day when He shall come
He will call all who sleep.
He will gather all the saints
To be together with Him.

When we come before His face
We shall serve Him with great joy.
With Him there is no evil thing;
Joy unending, all our days.

33.lyricsEnglish:
Behold the Bridegroom cometh
In the middle of the night,
And blest is he whose loins are girt,
Whose lamp is burning bright;
But woe to that dull servant
Whom the Master shall surprise
With lamp untrimmed, unburning,
And with slumber in his eyes.

Do thou, my soul, beware,
Be trimmed, and pouring oil,
Make ready for your journey,
And think not of repose,
O soul of mine, be watching,
The solemn hour is nigh,
When with the shout of trumpet
The Bridegroom draweth nigh.

Beware, my soul; take courage,
Watch, wait, and still proclaim
The glory of the Bridegroom,
The majesty of His name.
For they who with the Bridegroom
Have gone in to the feast
Shall see His face for ever,
And be His holy guests.

35.titleEnglish: Christians, awake, salute the happy morn
35.lyricsEnglish:
Christians, awake, salute the happy morn
Whereon the Saviour of the world was born;
Rise to adore the mystery of love,
Which hosts of angels chanted from above;
With them the joyful tidings first begun
Of God incarnate and the Virgin's Son.

Then to the watchful shepherds it was told,
Who heard the angelic herald's voice, "Behold,
I bring good tidings of a Saviour's birth
To you and all the nations upon earth;
This day hath God fulfilled His promised word,
This day is born a Saviour, Christ the Lord."

O may we keep and ponder in our mind
God's wondrous love in saving lost mankind;
Trace we the Babe, who hath retrieved our loss,
From His poor manger to His bitter cross;
Treading His steps, assisted by His grace,
Till man's first heavenly state again takes place.

36.titleEnglish: It came upon the midnight clear
36.lyricsEnglish:
It came upon the midnight clear,
That glorious song of old,
From angels bending near the earth
To touch their harps of gold:
"Peace on the earth, good will to men,
From heaven's all-gracious King."
The world in solemn stillness lay
To hear the angels sing.

Still through the cloven skies they come,
With peaceful wings unfurled,
And still their heavenly music floats
O'er all the weary world;
Above its sad and lowly plains
They bend on hovering wing,
And ever o'er its Babel sounds
The blessed angels sing.

For lo! the days are hastening on,
By prophet-bards foretold,
When with the ever-circling years
Comes round the age of gold;
When peace shall over all the earth
Its ancient splendours fling,
And the whole world give back the song
Which now the angels sing.

37.titleEnglish: When the Lord of all glory came
37.lyricsEnglish:
When the Lord of all glory came down to earth,
Shepherds and strangers ran quickly to Him;
When they saw Him worshipped with the angels
They sang: Joy, joy, joy indeed.
We praise Him, our Lord and yours.

So let us praise Him, the glorious One,
Come today and see that He is truly our Lord;
Let our voices join the angels' song.
They sang: Joy, joy, joy indeed.
We praise Him, our Lord and yours.

All creatures everywhere, children of God,
Understand the salvation we proclaim;
Look, all of you, and let us draw near.
They sang: Joy, joy, joy indeed.
We praise Him, our Lord and yours.

38.lyricsEnglish:
While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
All seated on the ground,
The angel of the Lord came down,
And glory shone around.

"Fear not," said he, for mighty dread
Had seized their troubled mind;
"Glad tidings of great joy I bring
To you and all mankind.

"To you, in David's town, this day
Is born of David's line
A Saviour, who is Christ the Lord,
And this shall be the sign:

"The heavenly Babe you there shall find
To human view displayed,
All meanly wrapped in swathing bands,
And in a manger laid."

Thus spake the seraph, and forthwith
Appeared a shining throng
Of angels praising God, who thus
Addressed their joyful song:

"All glory be to God on high,
And to the earth be peace;
Good will henceforth from heaven to men
Begin and never cease."

39.lyricsEnglish:
With great rejoicing sing,
Sing with abundant joy;
Jesus is our gladness,
Lying in the manger.
He shines with beauty
Upon His mother's breast,
Jesus, the beginning
And the end.

O Jesus, little Child,
You whom I long for always,
Have mercy, for I see
The Child above all others.
For all Your goodness,
You who are glorious,
I draw near to You,
I draw near to You.

The goodness of our Father,
The grace of Jesus the Son;
We the sheep had wandered
For all our many sins,
But He has given us
The joy of heaven.
If only we were there,
If only we were there.

Where has that joy gone,
Or is it not still there?
His angels
Sing a new song,
And the drums are sounding
Before the face of the King.
If only we were there,
If only we were there.

40.lyricsEnglish:
Once in royal David's city
Stood a lowly cattle shed,
Where a mother laid her Baby
In a manger for His bed:
Mary was that mother mild,
Jesus Christ her little Child.

He came down to earth from heaven,
Who is God and Lord of all,
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall;
With the poor, and mean, and lowly,
Lived on earth our Saviour holy.

And our eyes at last shall see Him,
Through His own redeeming love;
For that Child so dear and gentle
Is our Lord in heaven above,
And He leads His children on
To the place where He is gone.

Not in that poor lowly stable,
With the oxen standing by,
We shall see Him; but in heaven,
Set at God's right hand on high;
When like stars His children crowned
All in white shall wait around.

41.titleEnglish: Go, tell it on the mountain
41.lyricsEnglish:
Go, tell it on the mountain,
Over the hills and everywhere;
Go, tell it on the mountain
That Jesus Christ is born.

While shepherds kept their watching
O'er silent flocks by night,
Behold throughout the heavens
There shone a holy light.

The shepherds feared and trembled
When lo! above the earth
Rang out the angel chorus
That hailed our Saviour's birth.

Down in a lowly manger
The humble Christ was born,
And God sent us salvation
That blessed Christmas morn.

42.lyricsEnglish:
Today the angels
Sing unto the King
Who is born where we are.
See how He humbles Himself;
He has become a man
To lift us up.
Come, all the earth,
To give Him praise.
Today the angels sing unto the King.

Let us come and praise
Our Emmanuel,
The Virgin's Child,
Jesus the Saviour.
He has come, the light of the world,
To shine on us all,
That we may not walk
In the darkness of sin.
Today the angels sing unto the King.

Christ eternal,
The Lord of glory,
He is the King Himself,
Come to be with us.
He has come in humility,
In the form of a servant,
To die for us all,
That we may not be lost.
Today the angels sing unto the King.

43.lyricsEnglish:
In the days of winter,
There in Bethlehem,
A pure maiden
Bore her Child.

Rejoice, all of you,
Sing His praise;
Be glad, be glad,
Jesus is born.

Jesus is born
In His great mercy;
The host of angels
Give Him great praise.

The shepherds have come
To worship that Child;
The wise men bring
Frankincense and gold.

And the angels
Have come to greet
That Child in the manger:
He is our Lord.

He has come to redeem,
To be the Saviour;
He has come to conquer death.
Let us not lose heart.

He has come with love
To bring a blessing
To all His people,
And to teach us.

You lie in a stable,
You who came from heaven;
Thorns will pierce
Your brow, O Jesus.

Yet You love us,
With words of life,
And You teach us all
To follow You.

Let us serve Him
As the angels do;
So let us all rejoice:
He is born today.

44.lyricsEnglish:
My friend, remember, remember,
My friend, remember now:
Every moment passes very quickly;
But you, remember, and examine yourself.

In Bethlehem, my friend,
There in Bethlehem He was born;
He humbled Himself and died upon the tree
To save us from our sins.

So thank Him today in this feast,
Singing to Him with great joy;
Let us rejoice as we sing to Him,
And worship Him, for He is the Saviour.

45.titleEnglish: Angels we have heard on high
45.lyricsEnglish:
Angels we have heard on high,
Sweetly singing o'er the plains,
And the mountains in reply
Echoing their joyous strains.
Gloria in excelsis Deo.
Gloria in excelsis Deo.

Shepherds, why this jubilee?
Why your joyous strains prolong?
What the gladsome tidings be
Which inspire your heavenly song?
Gloria in excelsis Deo.
Gloria in excelsis Deo.

Come to Bethlehem and see
Him whose birth the angels sing;
Come, adore on bended knee
Christ the Lord, the newborn King.
Gloria in excelsis Deo.
Gloria in excelsis Deo.

46.lyricsEnglish:
On Christmas night
The voices of the bells
Rang out to tell
The news of joy,
To reach all people:
The Saviour is born.

The words of gladness
Spoken by those angels
Who announced His coming,
King of kings,
Lord of lords:
Let all give Him praise.

Now the Saviour
Is born where you are;
The angels sing
As they announce His coming.
In heaven and on earth
Let there be peace among you.

47.lyricsEnglish:
A great and mighty wonder,
A full and holy cure!
The Virgin bears the Infant
With virgin-honour pure.
Repeat the hymn again:
"To God on high be glory,
And peace on earth to men."

The Word becomes incarnate
And yet remains on high,
And cherubim sing anthems
To shepherds from the sky.
Repeat the hymn again:
"To God on high be glory,
And peace on earth to men."

While thus they sing your Monarch,
Those bright angelic bands,
Rejoice, ye vales and mountains,
Ye oceans, clap your hands.
Repeat the hymn again:
"To God on high be glory,
And peace on earth to men."

48.lyricsEnglish:
Of the Father's love begotten,
Ere the worlds began to be,
He is Alpha and Omega,
He the source, the ending He,
Of the things that are, that have been,
And that future years shall see,
Evermore and evermore.

O that birth for ever blessed,
When the Virgin, full of grace,
By the Holy Ghost conceiving,
Bare the Saviour of our race,
And the Babe, the world's Redeemer,
First revealed His sacred face,
Evermore and evermore.

O ye heights of heaven, adore Him;
Angel hosts, His praises sing;
Powers, dominions, bow before Him,
And extol our God and King;
Let no tongue on earth be silent,
Every voice in concert ring,
Evermore and evermore.

49.lyricsEnglish:
On this day
Jesus, the loving One,
Is born today:
This is Christmas.

Let us worship Him,
Our Saviour;
Give Him glory
As you rejoice today.

Jesus is love;
He loves us all.
Let us love Him too,
For He loved us first.

50.titleEnglish: Behold the Child in a stable
50.lyricsEnglish:
Behold the Child in a stable;
He is King of kings.
He has no place to be born,
Yet He bears our sins.

That holy Child,
The Saviour, humbles Himself
To live on earth in lowliness;
We shall see Him in glory.

Many prophets announced Him,
And the angels sang;
They said that He is born,
Worthy of great glory.

51.lyricsEnglish:
O little town of Bethlehem,
How still we see thee lie!
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep
The silent stars go by.
Yet in thy dark streets shineth
The everlasting Light;
The hopes and fears of all the years
Are met in thee tonight.

For Christ is born of Mary,
And gathered all above,
While mortals sleep, the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.
O morning stars, together
Proclaim the holy birth,
And praises sing to God the King,
And peace to men on earth.

How silently, how silently,
The wondrous gift is given!
So God imparts to human hearts
The blessings of His heaven.
No ear may hear His coming,
But in this world of sin,
Where meek souls will receive Him still,
The dear Christ enters in.

O holy Child of Bethlehem,
Descend to us, we pray;
Cast out our sin, and enter in,
Be born in us today.
We hear the Christmas angels
The great glad tidings tell;
O come to us, abide with us,
Our Lord Emmanuel.

52.lyricsEnglish:
Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
The little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head.
The stars in the bright sky looked down where He lay,
The little Lord Jesus asleep on the hay.

The cattle are lowing, the Baby awakes,
But little Lord Jesus, no crying He makes.
I love Thee, Lord Jesus! Look down from the sky,
And stay by my side until morning is nigh.

Be near me, Lord Jesus; I ask Thee to stay
Close by me for ever, and love me, I pray.
Bless all the dear children in Thy tender care,
And fit us for heaven to live with Thee there.

53.lyricsEnglish:
Jesus, Child of mercy,
And gentle Child,
Born in a stable,
You whom all praise.

You who were wrapped in swaddling clothes,
Deliver us from all our sins;
Guard our friends,
And give us Your blessing.

Jesus, who came as a babe,
Have mercy on our weakness;
All the children You created,
Give them Your blessing.

54.titleEnglish: I love the song the angels sang
54.lyricsEnglish:
I love the song
The angels sang
When they announced
The coming of Jesus.
I have no goodness;
I have many sins,
But He died for me,
Jesus the Saviour.

I know our Lord
Became a little child
To show the good way
That we should follow.
And if I strive
To be like Him,
He will not forget me,
For He loves me.

I cannot see Him
Now with my eyes,
But He will hear
The songs I sing.
If I obey Him
He will bring me home,
And I shall praise Him
As it is right to do.

55.titleEnglish: See the Child who is born
55.lyricsEnglish:
See the Child who is born,
Come down from heaven;
See, He has come as a babe,
Lord of kings.

Christ emptied Himself so;
He became a Child.
In the stable Mary
Bore Him.

Herod, so cruel,
Was greatly afraid,
And sent his men,
And they killed many children.

Child Jesus, what mercy
Compels us
To take that road
Which brings us to Him.

56.lyricsEnglish:
The hour has come;
Those in heaven are there.
They all give great praise,
Singing like this:
Glory be to God.

When the shepherds saw
The angels there,
Singing the song
That was a song of joy:
Glory be to God.

When they went to the stable
They saw the little Child;
They believed He was Christ,
And they knelt before Him:
Glory be to God.

And we, for His love,
Today let us sing,
Praising the Child
Who was born on earth:
Glory be to God.

57.lyricsEnglish:
The Child in Bethlehem,
In Bethlehem;
A little Child is born.
Hallelujah, hallelujah.

The sheep, the donkey, and the cattle,
Donkey and cattle,
Worshipped their King.
Hallelujah, hallelujah.

And with joy the saints,
The holy ones,
Saw salvation.
Hallelujah, hallelujah.

58.lyricsEnglish:
Great joy in heaven,
Harps are sounding,
And the angels
Sing aloud in the heights.
Glory be on high.

And we on earth,
Let us shout aloud:
Wa la la la la!
Rejoice on high.
Glory be on high.

Let us lift to You
All our hearts.
Your love is great,
The love that brought You to earth.
Glory be on high.

59.titleEnglish: Angels from the realms of glory
59.lyricsEnglish:
Angels from the realms of glory,
Wing your flight o'er all the earth;
Ye who sang creation's story
Now proclaim Messiah's birth:
Come and worship,
Worship Christ, the newborn King.

Shepherds in the field abiding,
Watching o'er your flocks by night,
God with man is now residing,
Yonder shines the infant Light:
Come and worship,
Worship Christ, the newborn King.

Sages, leave your contemplations,
Brighter visions beam afar;
Seek the great Desire of nations;
Ye have seen His natal star:
Come and worship,
Worship Christ, the newborn King.

Saints before the altar bending,
Watching long in hope and fear,
Suddenly the Lord, descending,
In His temple shall appear:
Come and worship,
Worship Christ, the newborn King.

60.lyricsEnglish:
When Jesus was born
In the city that was despised,
The angels sang:
Glory to God.

Let us rejoice and sing:
Jesus is born today.
The angels sing:
Glory to God.

When the shepherds heard
The song from heaven,
They rejoiced indeed:
Glory to God.

Today you who hear,
Go to Bethlehem,
And hear the song:
Glory to God.

61.lyricsEnglish:
My Father, I trust You
To be with me
In all that shall meet me
In this year.
I do not ask to be spared
Every trouble,
But I ask that Your name
May be praised.

What child chooses for himself
The things he wants?
A father does not refuse
His child what is good.
Every day You give us
Your blessings;
So I ask that Your name
May be praised.

If in this life You give me
Things that make me glad,
The joy that I have
Will only grow.
Let me always sing
Your mighty deeds;
In all things may Your name
Be praised.

If You call me to carry
Your cross,
And it brings me sorrow
And weariness,
Let me think of Jesus
In His glory.
Always may Your name
Be praised.

62.titleEnglish: We thank You for Your grace
62.lyricsEnglish:
We thank You for Your grace
That has brought us all
Into this new year.
Our Father, hear us.

In weakness and in sorrow
Let us run to You
When the way is lost;
Jesus, lead us on.

When we draw near
The valley of death,
Your rod and Your staff
Will be our comfort.

Let us always be
Faithful and pure;
Let us endure,
And You will give the crown.

In the heavenly land
We shall strike new harps,
Praising You alone,
You who rule all people.

63.titleEnglish: As with gladness men of old
63.lyricsEnglish:
As with gladness men of old
Did the guiding star behold;
As with joy they hailed its light,
Leading onward, beaming bright;
So, most gracious Lord, may we
Evermore be led to Thee.

As with joyful steps they sped,
Saviour, to Thy lowly bed,
There to bend the knee before
Thee, whom heaven and earth adore;
So may we with willing feet
Ever seek Thy mercy-seat.

As they offered gifts most rare
At Thy cradle, rude and bare,
So may we with holy joy,
Pure, and free from sin's alloy,
All our costliest treasures bring,
Christ, to Thee our heavenly King.

Holy Jesus, every day
Keep us in the narrow way;
And, when earthly things are past,
Bring our ransomed souls at last
Where they need no star to guide,
Where no clouds Thy glory hide.

64.titleEnglish: Brightest and best of the sons of the morning
64.lyricsEnglish:
Brightest and best of the sons of the morning,
Dawn on our darkness, and lend us thine aid;
Star of the east, the horizon adorning,
Guide where our infant Redeemer is laid.

Cold on His cradle the dew-drops are shining;
Low lies His head with the beasts of the stall;
Angels adore Him in slumber reclining,
Maker and Monarch and Saviour of all.

Say, shall we yield Him, in costly devotion,
Odours of Edom, and offerings divine,
Gems of the mountain and pearls of the ocean,
Myrrh from the forest or gold from the mine?

Vainly we offer each ample oblation,
Vainly with gifts would His favour secure;
Richer by far is the heart's adoration,
Dearer to God are the prayers of the poor.

65.titleEnglish: We three kings of Orient are
65.lyricsEnglish:
We three kings of Orient are;
Bearing gifts we traverse afar,
Field and fountain, moor and mountain,
Following yonder star.

O star of wonder, star of night,
Star with royal beauty bright,
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to thy perfect light.

Born a King on Bethlehem's plain,
Gold I bring to crown Him again,
King for ever, ceasing never,
Over us all to reign.

Frankincense to offer have I;
Incense owns a Deity nigh;
Prayer and praising, all men raising,
Worship Him, God most high.

Myrrh is mine; its bitter perfume
Breathes a life of gathering gloom;
Sorrowing, sighing, bleeding, dying,
Sealed in the stone-cold tomb.

Glorious now behold Him arise,
King and God and sacrifice;
Alleluia, Alleluia,
Sounds through the earth and skies.

66.lyricsEnglish:
Behold the fairest star,
The star of grace and truth,
Shining today.
Son of David, look on me
With Your eyes;
Light comes from You.
My Jesus,
You are near, O glorious King,
Conqueror of all.

My soul rejoices
Because the eyes of Jesus
See His servant.
Jesus, You are most fair;
My heart and my life,
And all my wisdom:
Stay with me
For ever and ever. Hosanna,
Life that never ends.

So now I rejoice,
For I know that Jesus
Loves me, His beloved.
He holds me by the hand,
He keeps me on His breast;
We shall go together.
Come quickly:
The crown of great worth, do not delay;
The bride is waiting for You.

67.lyricsEnglish:
The people who sat
In the darkness of the earth,
A sun has risen on them
To drive away death.

You have lifted our burdens
And broken the yoke,
As You did to the enemy
In the day of Midian.

His name shall be called
King of power,
King of peace,
God, the beloved.

Come, holy Sun,
Shine on every land;
Let all be filled with Your joy
In their hearts.

A Child is born to us,
A Son is given to us;
His authority shall rule
In heaven and on earth.

His power shall spread
Through every nation,
And His righteous judgments
Shall last for ever.

So, Jesus, come today,
Together with the Father
And the Holy Spirit:
Rule over us indeed.

68.titleEnglish: Jesus our Lord, bear with us
68.lyricsEnglish:
Jesus our Lord,
Bear with us;
We have humbled ourselves today.

Jesus, You who are holy,
Straighten our spirits
While we still have time.

Fill us with the Spirit,
The Helper full of grace,
That we may hold the truth.

For the sweat of blood,
And all Your tears
That You shed upon the earth.

For the great love
That made You die for us,
Jesus, hear us.

69.lyricsEnglish:
O God, when they were sorely
Thirsty, the people of Israel,
You commanded Moses thus:
Strike the rock with your staff.

From the rock that was struck
Much water came forth;
Those who were thirsty
Drank, and were glad.

When we look upon that rock
We see Jesus in the figure:
He who was struck long ago for us,
And His blood flowed out.

While we live in this world
Our spirits grow thirsty;
Does it not belong to us,
The water of life?

70.lyricsEnglish:
Jesus, before Your face
We kneel today.
We confess many sins,
And tears come,
For the great love
That brought You to earth.
As You stand on high,
Jesus, hear us.

For Your great mercy
That made You a child,
And for Your birth
When You became a man;
For Your temptation,
So fearful in the desert,
As You stand on high,
Jesus, hear us.

For Your compassion
When Your spirit was troubled
At the tomb of Lazarus,
And over Jerusalem;
For the sweat of blood
And Your many prayers,
As You stand on high,
Jesus, hear us.

For the great suffering,
For the many prayers,
For the crown of thorns
And the nails,
The spear in Your side,
And the fearful cry,
You gave Your life.
Jesus, hear us.

71.lyricsEnglish:
My sins have wearied me,
And I long for rest.
You are my refuge, Jesus,
Where I hide every day.
You are my advocate,
Truly my Lord.

Your love is greater
Than the power of my sins.
I have come to You; it has overcome me.
Stretch out Your arms:
Draw the sinner near,
And wash him in Your blood.

Lead me in Your way;
Let me walk in Your steps.
Of Your mercy give me strength
Not to sin again.
What has fallen in my soul,
Set it right indeed.

A spirit that fears You,
That loves Your law,
Give it to me, Your servant,
That I may not leave Your sight.
Jesus my Lord, I
Commit myself into Your hands.

72.lyricsEnglish:
We are sinners indeed,
Bound by our sins.
You who help the poor,
Have mercy, Jesus.

We have no goodness
In anything we do.
You understand how we are;
Have mercy, Jesus.

We could never go
To You in Your glory,
You who are acquainted with sorrow;
Have mercy, Jesus.

Satan bound us
In the prison of sin.
Make us free,
Have mercy, Jesus.

There is One in heaven
Who alone can save us;
He does not shut us out.
Have mercy, Jesus.

He is our advocate
Before the face of God.
Through Him we overcome;
We shall reach heaven.

73.lyricsEnglish:
In our great need
We call, O God:
Have mercy, incline Your ear,
Hear us for Your mercy's sake.
Lord, if You should look
On the sins and shame of people,
Who could stand?

But this we know:
There is forgiveness
With You, our God,
Who hears and has mercy.
Your word, O Lord,
Is hope for every day;
I wait for You, O Lord.

The watchmen waited
For the morning to break,
But my soul longs even more,
Yearning for God,
For where the Lord is
There is mercy.
Let all put their hope in Him.

74.titleEnglish: My sins have made me weary
74.lyricsEnglish:
My sins have made me weary;
I long greatly to reach heaven.
Nothing unclean may enter there,
But a voice calls me: Come.

I have been a slave of sin from of old;
How could I hope to stand
Before the Lord of spirits?
Yet He is willing to draw me near.

When I want to do what is good,
Sin is close to me always;
But I hear You say,
Repent, believe, and you shall be saved.

I hear Your voice, Jesus;
Your hands draw me near,
And Your blood pleads for me,
Shed long ago upon the cross.

Saviour of those who have sin,
Clothe me with righteousness,
That I may be hidden in You alone,
Who took from me the wages of sin.

75.titleEnglish: Have mercy on us, the poor
75.lyricsEnglish:
Have mercy on us, the poor;
We are sad because of sin.
Be our Saviour,
For You are merciful.

Forgive those who repent;
Let us walk before You
As sinners who are forgiven,
Thanking the Saviour.

We have come to You, Saviour,
You who died for people,
And we sinners
Know that You have mercy.

We no longer fear the enemy;
He has no power left.
So let us trust You.
Have mercy, Saviour.

76.lyricsEnglish:
All glory, laud, and honour
To Thee, Redeemer, King,
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet hosannas ring.

Thou art the King of Israel,
Thou David's royal Son,
Who in the Lord's name comest,
The King and blessed One.

The company of angels
Are praising Thee on high,
And mortal men and all things
Created make reply.

The people of the Hebrews
With palms before Thee went;
Our praise and prayer and anthems
Before Thee we present.

To Thee, before Thy passion,
They sang their hymns of praise;
To Thee, now high exalted,
Our melody we raise.

78.titleEnglish: Ride on, ride on in majesty
78.lyricsEnglish:
Ride on, ride on in majesty!
Hark, all the tribes hosanna cry;
Thine humble beast pursues his road
With palms and scattered garments strowed.

Ride on, ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die:
O Christ, Thy triumphs now begin
O'er captive death and conquered sin.

Ride on, ride on in majesty!
The winged squadrons of the sky
Look down with sad and wondering eyes
To see the approaching sacrifice.

Ride on, ride on in majesty!
Thy last and fiercest strife is nigh;
The Father on His sapphire throne
Awaits His own anointed Son.

Ride on, ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die;
Bow Thy meek head to mortal pain,
Then take, O God, Thy power, and reign.

79.lyricsEnglish:
O sacred Head, sore wounded,
Defiled and put to scorn;
O kingly Head, surrounded
With mocking crown of thorn:
What sorrow mars Thy grandeur?
Can death Thy bloom deflower?
O countenance whose splendour
The hosts of heaven adore.

Thy grief and bitter passion
Were all for sinners' gain;
Mine, mine was the transgression,
But Thine the deadly pain.
Lo, here I fall, my Saviour:
'Tis I deserve Thy place;
Look on me with Thy favour,
Vouchsafe to me Thy grace.

What language shall I borrow
To thank Thee, dearest Friend,
For this Thy dying sorrow,
Thy pity without end?
O make me Thine for ever,
And, should I fainting be,
Lord, let me never, never
Outlive my love to Thee.

80.lyricsEnglish:
That love of the Saviour,
The love with which He loved me,
Though I was not worthy:
Who then am I,
A sinner?
Yet He died for me.

They praised Him greatly,
Singing songs,
Singing songs,
And all of them said:
Hosanna on high!
And then at once
They said:
Praise the Saviour.

He had no house,
You who made the earth.
In death, everyone
Forsook You.
How shall I speak,
O Saviour,
Of love like Yours for me?

He left His glory
And brought to people
His salvation,
To us who were not worthy.
He loved me,
A sinner,
And gave everything for me.

But what did He do?
He healed the sick;
All the lame,
And the blind,
He healed them.
A wonder:
Now they insult Him.

Let me keep singing
Of my Friend.
He is the King, yet
He loves me so
Through all my life.
Let me love You, Saviour.

81.titleEnglish: There is a green hill far away
81.lyricsEnglish:
There is a green hill far away,
Without a city wall,
Where the dear Lord was crucified,
Who died to save us all.

We may not know, we cannot tell,
What pains He had to bear,
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffered there.

He died that we might be forgiven,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heaven,
Saved by His precious blood.

There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin;
He only could unlock the gate
Of heaven, and let us in.

O dearly, dearly has He loved,
And we must love Him too,
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His works to do.

82.titleEnglish: Ah, holy Jesus, how hast Thou offended
82.lyricsEnglish:
Ah, holy Jesus, how hast Thou offended,
That man to judge Thee hath in hate pretended?
By foes derided, by Thine own rejected,
O most afflicted.

Who was the guilty? Who brought this upon Thee?
Alas, my treason, Jesus, hath undone Thee.
'Twas I, Lord Jesus, I it was denied Thee:
I crucified Thee.

Lo, the good Shepherd for the sheep is offered;
The slave hath sinned, and the Son hath suffered;
For man's atonement, while he nothing heedeth,
God intercedeth.

For me, kind Jesus, was Thy incarnation,
Thy mortal sorrow, and Thy life's oblation;
Thy death of anguish and Thy bitter passion,
For my salvation.

83.lyricsEnglish:
Jesus Christ is risen today, Alleluia!
Our triumphant holy day, Alleluia!
Who did once, upon the cross, Alleluia!
Suffer to redeem our loss. Alleluia!

Hymns of praise then let us sing, Alleluia!
Unto Christ, our heavenly King, Alleluia!
Who endured the cross and grave, Alleluia!
Sinners to redeem and save. Alleluia!

But the pains which He endured, Alleluia!
Our salvation have procured; Alleluia!
Now above the sky He's King, Alleluia!
Where the angels ever sing. Alleluia!

Sing we to our God above, Alleluia!
Praise eternal as His love; Alleluia!
Praise Him, all ye heavenly host, Alleluia!
Father, Son, and Holy Ghost. Alleluia!

84.lyricsEnglish:
Jesus lives! thy terrors now
Can, O death, no more appal us;
Jesus lives! by this we know
Thou, O grave, canst not enthral us.
Alleluia!

Jesus lives! henceforth is death
But the gate of life immortal;
This shall calm our trembling breath
When we pass its gloomy portal.
Alleluia!

Jesus lives! for us He died;
Then, alone to Jesus living,
Pure in heart may we abide,
Glory to our Saviour giving.
Alleluia!

Jesus lives! our hearts know well
Nought from us His love shall sever;
Life, nor death, nor powers of hell
Tear us from His keeping ever.
Alleluia!

85.titleEnglish: Jesus, who was in the bonds of death
85.lyricsEnglish:
Jesus, who was in the bonds
Of death for our sake,
Conquered and rose again,
And gave us life.
Let us thank Him greatly;
Let us sing with joy,
Singing Hallelujah!
Hallelujah!

His life fought
Death and the grave,
And there was a great wonder:
Death fled.
Jesus conquered it,
As the book of God
Bears witness.
Hallelujah!

Keep well this feast
As we are filled with joy.
Jesus is the Sun of souls;
He has risen among us.
Show us His ways;
Let Him appear among us,
That we may not shame His name.
Hallelujah!

86.lyricsEnglish:
Alleluia, alleluia!
Hearts to heaven and voices raise;
Sing to God a hymn of gladness,
Sing to God a hymn of praise;
He who on the cross a victim
For the world's salvation bled,
Jesus Christ, the King of Glory,
Now is risen from the dead.

Christ is risen, Christ the first-fruits
Of the holy harvest field,
Which will all its full abundance
At His second coming yield;
Then the golden ears of harvest
Will their heads before Him wave,
Ripened by His glorious sunshine,
From the furrows of the grave.

Alleluia, alleluia!
Glory be to God on high;
Alleluia to the Saviour,
Who has gained the victory;
Alleluia to the Spirit,
Fount of love and sanctity;
Alleluia, alleluia,
To the Triune Majesty.

87.lyricsEnglish:
On that great day
Jesus will appear;
He will gather us all,
His children.

Every part of us,
Body and spirit,
Will be carried to where He is,
In heaven.

It will be heard on earth
For a little while:
The body that sleeps
Is at rest.

And the spirit that does not die
Will remain alone,
Still waiting for Him,
For His coming.

But on that day
They will be joined indeed,
The body clothed
With what cannot die.

Our joy will be
Great on His day,
When we see Jesus
In heaven.

O Lord Jesus,
Gather us all
On the road that leads us
Home to You.

88.lyricsEnglish:
This joyful Eastertide,
Away with sin and sorrow.
My Love, the Crucified,
Hath sprung to life this morrow:

Had Christ, that once was slain,
Ne'er burst His three-day prison,
Our faith had been in vain:
But now hath Christ arisen,
Arisen, arisen, arisen.

My flesh in hope shall rest,
And for a season slumber:
Till trump from east to west
Shall wake the dead in number.

Death's flood hath lost its chill,
Since Jesus crossed the river;
Lover of souls, from ill
My passing soul deliver.

89.titleEnglish: Hallelujah! Jesus has driven out death
89.lyricsEnglish:
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Jesus has driven out death.
Death is dead; He has conquered.
So sing and give thanks.
Hallelujah!

See, the powers of death
Have all been silenced.
They are defeated, driven away.
Hallelujah!

On the third day He left
His tomb and rose again.
Let us go on singing
All the more.
Hallelujah!

Jesus, heal us in death
And in the bonds that held us;
Let us be alive to You.
Hallelujah!

90.titleEnglish: Low in the grave He lay
90.lyricsEnglish:
Low in the grave He lay,
Jesus my Saviour,
Waiting the coming day,
Jesus my Lord.

Up from the grave He arose,
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes;
He arose a victor from the dark domain,
And He lives for ever with His saints to reign.
He arose! He arose!
Hallelujah! Christ arose!

Vainly they watch His bed,
Jesus my Saviour;
Vainly they seal the dead,
Jesus my Lord.

Death cannot keep its prey,
Jesus my Saviour;
He tore the bars away,
Jesus my Lord.

91.lyricsEnglish:
Alleluia, sing to Jesus!
His the sceptre, His the throne;
Alleluia, His the triumph,
His the victory alone.
Hark, the songs of peaceful Zion
Thunder like a mighty flood:
"Jesus out of every nation
Hath redeemed us by His blood."

Alleluia, not as orphans
Are we left in sorrow now;
Alleluia, He is near us,
Faith believes, nor questions how.
Though the cloud from sight received Him,
When the forty days were o'er,
Shall our hearts forget His promise,
"I am with you evermore"?

Alleluia, bread of angels,
Thou on earth our food, our stay;
Alleluia, here the sinful
Flee to Thee from day to day.
Intercessor, Friend of sinners,
Earth's Redeemer, plead for me,
Where the songs of all the sinless
Sweep across the crystal sea.

92.lyricsEnglish:
The day of resurrection!
Earth, tell it out abroad;
The Passover of gladness,
The Passover of God.
From death to life eternal,
From earth unto the sky,
Our Christ hath brought us over
With hymns of victory.

Our hearts be pure from evil,
That we may see aright
The Lord in rays eternal
Of resurrection light;
And, listening to His accents,
May hear, so calm and plain,
His own "All hail" and, hearing,
May raise the victor strain.

Now let the heavens be joyful,
Let earth her song begin,
The round world keep high triumph,
And all that is therein;
Let all things seen and unseen
Their notes of gladness blend,
For Christ the Lord is risen,
Our Joy that hath no end.

93.titleEnglish: The King, our Lord, invites us
93.lyricsEnglish:
The King, our Lord,
Invites us to His feast;
He has prepared the banquet.
Let us hurry to go.

Christ, our Passover,
The Lamb of God, Jesus,
Who was given for us,
That we might overcome.

Christ came from His tomb
With great victory
And power, to save
Sinners who trust Him.

Hallelujah, hallelujah;
You are worthy of glory,
And You, God our Father,
And the Holy Spirit.

94.titleEnglish: The strife is o'er, the battle done
94.lyricsEnglish:
Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!
The strife is o'er, the battle done;
Now is the Victor's triumph won;
O let the song of praise be sung:
Alleluia!

Death's mightiest powers have done their worst,
And Jesus hath His foes dispersed;
Let shouts of praise and joy outburst:
Alleluia!

On the third morn He rose again
Glorious in majesty to reign;
O let us swell the joyful strain:
Alleluia!

Lord, by the stripes which wounded Thee,
From death's dread sting Thy servants free,
That we may live, and sing to Thee:
Alleluia!

96.titleEnglish: Hail the day that sees Him rise
96.lyricsEnglish:
Hail the day that sees Him rise, Alleluia!
To His throne above the skies; Alleluia!
Christ, the Lamb for sinners given, Alleluia!
Enters now the highest heaven. Alleluia!

There for Him high triumph waits; Alleluia!
Lift your heads, eternal gates. Alleluia!
He hath conquered death and sin; Alleluia!
Take the King of glory in. Alleluia!

Lo, the heaven its Lord receives, Alleluia!
Yet He loves the earth He leaves; Alleluia!
Though returning to His throne, Alleluia!
Still He calls mankind His own. Alleluia!

Lord, though parted from our sight, Alleluia!
Far above the starry height, Alleluia!
Grant our hearts may thither rise, Alleluia!
Seeking Thee above the skies. Alleluia!

97.lyricsEnglish:
We worship Your name greatly,
O Jesus, Lord,
Together with all people.
Our King, Jesus, rules all things.

Thank Him, you who were lost,
That He might find you.
Worship Him who died for you:
Our King, Jesus, rules all things.

And you, His Israel,
Who have been redeemed,
Worship the Son of David:
Our King, Jesus, rules all things.

People who were forgiven
By His grace,
Kneel before Jesus:
Our King, Jesus, rules all things.

All the nations of the earth,
Hear Jesus:
Let His name be worshipped.
Our King, Jesus, rules all things.

We long to arrive
Before the face of Jesus,
To praise Him always:
Our King, Jesus, rules all things.

99.lyricsEnglish:
Crown Him with many crowns,
The Lamb upon His throne;
Hark! how the heavenly anthem drowns
All music but its own.
Awake, my soul, and sing
Of Him who died for thee,
And hail Him as thy matchless King
Through all eternity.

Crown Him the Son of Man,
Who every grief hath known,
Who took our nature as His own,
And for our sin was slain.
His glories now we sing,
Who died and rose on high,
Who died eternal life to bring,
And lives that death may die.

Crown Him the Lord of life,
Who triumphed o'er the grave,
And rose victorious in the strife
For those He came to save.
His glories now we sing,
Who died, and rose on high,
Who died eternal life to bring,
And lives that death may die.

Crown Him the Lord of heaven,
Enthroned in worlds above,
Crown Him the King to whom is given
The wondrous name of Love.
Crown Him with many crowns,
As thrones before Him fall;
Crown Him, ye kings, with many crowns,
For He is King of all.

100.titleEnglish: Sing to the Lord, all people
100.lyricsEnglish:
Sing to the Lord,
All you people of the earth,
For the great victory
When Jesus rose again.
And all you in heaven,
Sing as you wait for Him;
He comes with victory.

For us He suffered,
And there in the tomb
The enemy was conquered,
And we were set free.
We are no longer slaves:
Blessed be His name
For His victory.

Be praised, O You,
For Your salvation,
And You, our Father,
Worthy of glory,
And You, O Spirit:
Let us praise You,
One God alone.

101.titleEnglish: See the Conqueror mounts in triumph
101.lyricsEnglish:
See the Conqueror mounts in triumph,
See the King in royal state
Riding on the clouds His chariot
To His heavenly palace gate;
Hark, the choirs of angel voices
Joyful alleluias sing,
And the portals high are lifted
To receive their heavenly King.

Who is this that comes in glory,
With the trump of jubilee?
Lord of battles, God of armies,
He has gained the victory;
He who on the cross did suffer,
He who from the grave arose,
He has vanquished sin and Satan,
He by death has spoiled His foes.

Thou hast raised our human nature
On the clouds to God's right hand;
There we sit in heavenly places,
There with Thee in glory stand.
Jesus reigns, adored by angels;
Man with God is on the throne;
Mighty Lord, in Thine ascension
We by faith behold our own.

102.lyricsEnglish:
Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove,
With all Thy quickening powers;
Kindle a flame of sacred love
In these cold hearts of ours.

Look how we grovel here below,
Fond of these trifling toys;
Our souls can neither fly nor go
To reach eternal joys.

In vain we tune our formal songs,
In vain we strive to rise;
Hosannas languish on our tongues,
And our devotion dies.

Dear Lord, and shall we ever live
At this poor dying rate?
Our love so faint, so cold to Thee,
And Thine to us so great!

Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove,
With all Thy quickening powers;
Come, shed abroad a Saviour's love,
And that shall kindle ours.

103.titleEnglish: When God of old came down from heaven
103.lyricsEnglish:
When God of old came down from heaven,
In power and wrath He came;
Before His feet the clouds were riven,
Half earth was wrapped in flame.

But when He came the second time,
He came in power and love;
Softer than gale at morning prime
Hovered His holy Dove.

The fires that rushed on Sinai down
In sudden torrents dread,
Now gently light, a glorious crown,
On every sainted head.

And as on Israel's awe-struck ear
The voice exceeding loud,
The trump that angels quake to hear,
Thrilled from the deep, dark cloud;

So, when the Spirit of our God
Came down His flock to find,
A voice from heaven was heard abroad,
A rushing, mighty wind.

104.titleEnglish: Come, Holy Ghost, our souls inspire
104.lyricsEnglish:
Come, Holy Ghost, our souls inspire,
And lighten with celestial fire;
Thou the anointing Spirit art,
Who dost Thy sevenfold gifts impart.

Thy blessed unction from above
Is comfort, life, and fire of love;
Enable with perpetual light
The dulness of our blinded sight.

Anoint and cheer our soiled face
With the abundance of Thy grace:
Keep far our foes, give peace at home;
Where Thou art guide no ill can come.

Teach us to know the Father, Son,
And Thee, of both, to be but One;
That through the ages all along
This may be our endless song:
Praise to Thy eternal merit,
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

105.lyricsEnglish:
Holy Spirit,
Enter into us;
Let our hearts
Be filled with love.
Our Helper, shine
Through all our life.

Holy Spirit,
Take out of us
Every desire
That is not fitting.
Let the shining light
Illumine our souls.

Holy Spirit,
Give us love for one another;
Help us to fulfil
The law of Jesus.
Bind us in humility;
Make us sorry for sin.

Holy Spirit,
Enable us
To accomplish
What Jesus desires.
Let us long for God
In all that He has planned for us.

107.titleEnglish: The saints of God! their conflict past
107.lyricsEnglish:
The saints of God! their conflict past,
And life's long battle won at last,
No more they need the shield or sword,
They cast them down before their Lord:
O happy saints, for ever blest,
At Jesus' feet how safe your rest!

The saints of God! their wanderings done,
No more their weary course they run,
No more they faint, no more they fall,
No foes await, no fears appal:
O happy saints, for ever blest,
In that dear home how sweet your rest!

The saints of God! life's voyage o'er,
Safe landed on that blissful shore,
No stormy tempests now they dread,
No roaring billows lift their head:
O happy saints, for ever blest,
In that calm haven of your rest!

109.titleEnglish: The Son of God goes forth to war
109.lyricsEnglish:
The Son of God goes forth to war,
A kingly crown to gain;
His blood-red banner streams afar:
Who follows in His train?
Who best can drink His cup of woe,
Triumphant over pain,
Who patient bears his cross below,
He follows in His train.

The martyr first, whose eagle eye
Could pierce beyond the grave,
Who saw his Master in the sky,
And called on Him to save.
Like Him, with pardon on his tongue
In midst of mortal pain,
He prayed for them that did the wrong:
Who follows in His train?

A glorious band, the chosen few
On whom the Spirit came,
Twelve valiant saints, their hope they knew,
And mocked the cross and flame.
They met the tyrant's brandished steel,
The lion's gory mane,
They bowed their necks the death to feel:
Who follows in His train?

A noble army, men and boys,
The matron and the maid,
Around the Saviour's throne rejoice,
In robes of light arrayed.
They climbed the steep ascent of heaven
Through peril, toil, and pain:
O God, to us may grace be given
To follow in their train.

110.lyricsEnglish:
For all the saints who from their labours rest,
Who Thee by faith before the world confessed,
Thy name, O Jesus, be for ever blest.
Alleluia! Alleluia!

Thou wast their Rock, their Fortress, and their Might;
Thou, Lord, their Captain in the well-fought fight;
Thou, in the darkness drear, their one true Light.
Alleluia! Alleluia!

O may Thy soldiers, faithful, true, and bold,
Fight as the saints who nobly fought of old,
And win, with them, the victor's crown of gold.
Alleluia! Alleluia!

O blest communion, fellowship divine!
We feebly struggle, they in glory shine;
Yet all are one in Thee, for all are Thine.
Alleluia! Alleluia!

From earth's wide bounds, from ocean's farthest coast,
Through gates of pearl streams in the countless host,
Singing to Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.
Alleluia! Alleluia!

111.lyricsEnglish:
Let us walk with those
Who seek Your name,
And with Your saints,
For ever and ever.

See the host of the holy
And rejoice with them;
And when I am sad
It puts strength in me again.

We do not see them now;
They have finished the race.
We too are on the journey;
We shall be with them.

All of us together are in You.
We do not see them with our eyes,
But by faith
We are in one flock.

Before Your face, together,
We praise You always.
In the spirit we meet,
And thank You for Your grace.

The whole host of heaven,
Those are the ones I shall be with;
And You, the Beloved,
Who shall separate us?

112.lyricsEnglish:
Father who loves us,
We bring this child to You.
Let the child enter the flock
And be held in love.

Your beloved Son
Did not send the little ones away;
And now we give this child
Into Your hands.

In days of trial
Give victory,
And show Your glory,
That all may praise You.

And at the end,
When You come in Your glory,
May the child rejoice to receive
The crown You promised.

113.lyricsEnglish:
Into Your hands, Jesus,
We bring this child;
At this baptism
We ask You to keep the child.

We know Your love
For all children,
For You rebuked those
Who would send them away.

We also pray today,
As we bring this one,
Receive Your child
For ever and ever.

The enemy is strong,
But You are stronger.
Keep us on the way,
And bring us to heaven.

114.lyricsEnglish:
Saviour Jesus,
You who call us in this world
To follow You,
Now we have come to You.

We have begun the journey
Through this world.
Hold us by the hand,
That we may overcome.

We are truly weak;
You are strong.
Now we promise
To follow You.

We fear no danger,
For You promised
That in Your hands
We are truly free.

The journey is long
And the snares are many,
But when we are with You
We shall reach heaven.

117.titleEnglish: We are glad to come before You
117.lyricsEnglish:
We are glad to come before You;
Today we promise before Your face
To be Your children all our days,
And to serve You faithfully.

But we know this well:
We can do nothing without You.
Yet You promised us this:
You will be with us always.

We know that You are faithful;
You will not leave us on the way.
So let that hope make us strong,
And bring us at last to heaven.

Call us to serve You;
We give our whole life.
Let us serve You as we ought,
That You may be glorified on earth.

118.titleEnglish: Take my life, and let it be
118.lyricsEnglish:
Take my life, and let it be
Consecrated, Lord, to Thee.
Take my moments and my days;
Let them flow in ceaseless praise.

Take my hands, and let them move
At the impulse of Thy love.
Take my feet, and let them be
Swift and beautiful for Thee.

Take my voice, and let me sing
Always, only, for my King.
Take my lips, and let them be
Filled with messages from Thee.

Take my silver and my gold;
Not a mite would I withhold.
Take my intellect, and use
Every power as Thou shalt choose.

Take my will, and make it Thine;
It shall be no longer mine.
Take my heart, it is Thine own;
It shall be Thy royal throne.

Take my love; my Lord, I pour
At Thy feet its treasure store.
Take myself, and I will be
Ever, only, all for Thee.

119.titleEnglish: Take up thy cross, the Saviour said
119.lyricsEnglish:
Take up thy cross, the Saviour said,
If thou wouldst My disciple be;
Deny thyself, the world forsake,
And humbly follow after Me.

Take up thy cross; let not its weight
Fill thy weak spirit with alarm;
His strength shall bear thy spirit up,
And brace thy heart, and nerve thine arm.

Take up thy cross, nor heed the shame,
Nor let thy foolish pride rebel;
Thy Lord for thee the cross endured,
To save thy soul from death and hell.

Take up thy cross, and follow Christ,
Nor think till death to lay it down;
For only he who bears the cross
May hope to wear the glorious crown.

120.titleEnglish: My God, I have given You
120.lyricsEnglish:
My God, I have given You
My whole spirit;
Let me never leave You
Through all ages.

I have drawn near Your feet,
You who were crucified:
Crucify my sins,
That I may serve You alone.

By Your mercy make me holy;
Make me Yours,
That I may see Your face
And praise You.

I have given You all I do
And all I think.
Let me serve You in life,
And in death be with You.

The desert is wide,
The way I pass through,
But let me hurry to You
Until my thirst is gone.

121.lyricsEnglish:
He will come: that hope
Strengthens our spirits.
The time is short
Until He returns,
And we shall rejoice,
All of us, when Jesus comes.

Those we loved,
When they have fallen asleep
And we are anxious
And live in sorrow,
Let us cease our weeping;
We shall be healed when He comes.

When we see sorrow
We are not angry at all.
The loss of our people
And the grief we see,
Let us bear it
Until He comes.

Let us eat of His feast,
The wine and the bread.
These are reminders
Until the day
When He will feed us all,
Those He called, when He comes.

122.lyricsEnglish:
Hunger and thirst
Bite me: give me
The water of life
And the food that comes from You.

You who were tempted
For my sake, O Lord,
Give me the bread of life,
That I may not die.

You, O Vine,
Who bring life,
Give me Your wine to drink;
Let my spirit rest.

I am weary of weariness;
The journey is too much.
Feed me with Your food;
Be with me, Saviour.

The desert is wide,
The way I pass through,
But let me hurry to You
Until my thirst is gone.

123.lyricsEnglish:
Come and receive the memorial
Of the death and suffering of Jesus.

All who believe His sacrifice,
For their sins, shall be saved.

His blood and body feed
Our souls, by faith.

He who gave us our salvation
Is Himself here in our midst.

Let us draw near in faith
And receive the strength we need.

Jesus, host of this feast,
We shall be with You in heaven.

124.lyricsEnglish:
King of mercy, look
Today on us, Your children, who pray.

You, the Shepherd who redeemed,
Keep all Your sheep today.

Saviour who died for us,
Today give us life that does not end.

You, the food of life, feed us,
That we may find much strength in the spirit.

Be with us wherever we go,
Our ruler and our tree of life.

So when death is finished
We shall arrive with joy in heaven.

125.lyricsEnglish:
Jesus, Your body is the food
That feeds all the earth.
You, the life of all people,
You died for us: heal us.

Look on our sighing
And all our weeping.
Let this feast teach us
How You satisfy us in hunger.

126.lyricsEnglish:
See my table
Filled with the feast.
Come to this banquet;
Eat the bread of life.

Whoever is thirsty,
Whoever hunger bites,
Let them come quickly where I am,
And I will feed them.

I am the good bread
Which my Father gave you,
Bringing to the earth
Life that does not end.

127.lyricsEnglish:
My soul, prepare yourself;
Prepare yourself with joy.
Come out of the dark of sorrow;
See the light of the world.
Rejoice with strength;
Praise the Lord
Who has set this feast
To feed His chosen ones.

Jesus, bread from heaven,
Jesus who gives life,
Draw me to the table today;
Draw a poor sinner freely.
Grant, at this feast,
That I may understand Your love.
Bring me, Your servant,
Into the palace as a guest.

129.lyricsEnglish:
Christ thus gave Himself
For us, upon the tree;
So we also give ourselves
To be saved.

His body is the food
That feeds those in need.
His word does not pass away
Through all ages.

Feed us with Your body;
Let us drink Your blood,
That as we draw near to You
We may receive life.

Glory to the Father
And to the Son,
And to the Holy Spirit,
Through all ages.

130.lyricsEnglish:
Jesus, in our midst,
Stand among us today.
By Your resurrection
Give us of Your strength,
And let us walk
In Your way with joy
And with all faithfulness.

132.titleEnglish: Glory be to God on high
132.lyricsEnglish:
Glory be to God on high,
And in earth peace, goodwill towards men.
We praise Thee, we bless Thee, we worship Thee,
We glorify Thee, we give thanks to Thee
For Thy great glory,
O Lord God, heavenly King,
God the Father Almighty.

O Lord, the only-begotten Son, Jesu Christ;
O Lord God, Lamb of God, Son of the Father,
That takest away the sins of the world,
Have mercy upon us.
Thou that takest away the sins of the world,
Have mercy upon us.
Thou that takest away the sins of the world,
Receive our prayer.
Thou that sittest at the right hand of God the Father,
Have mercy upon us.

For Thou only art holy,
Thou only art the Lord,
Thou only, O Christ, with the Holy Ghost,
Art most high in the glory of God the Father.

133.lyricsEnglish:
Strengthen, O God, the hands
That hold Your food.
Those who have heard Your songs
Must not hope in sin.

We who have sung Holy
Must not lie.
Those who have seen Your love,
Let us see Your hope.

We who have come into Your temple
Must not go astray.
Those fed by Your Spirit,
Give us life.

135.titleEnglish: We have come to You, O God
135.lyricsEnglish:
We have come to You, O God,
God of love,
Praying for these two:
Join them together.

When they are glad
And the journey is good,
Let them trust You alone,
And in You be one.

And in days of sorrow,
When the storm beats hard,
Let them trust You still;
Be with them.

Whatever shall meet them,
Whether joy or grief,
Give them Your grace;
Be with them.

In sickness and in health,
In poverty and in wealth,
Let Your great love
Surround them.

136.titleEnglish: O Love, You who surpass all
136.lyricsEnglish:
O Love, You who surpass all things,
We kneel to pray to You:
Those You have joined to be one,
Let them abide with You all their days.

O Life, reveal to them
The love of Your great mercy,
A faith that is truly strong,
And trust like that of a little child.

Gladden them when they are in sorrow;
Give them peace that does not end.
Give them blessing in their life;
Let them love one another always.

137.titleEnglish: All people that on earth do dwell

138.lyricsEnglish:
O God, when I think
Of the many things You gave me,
My soul wonders,
And it praises You.

Even when I was still being made,
Your great joy
You planted in my spirit,
Meaning to give me as Yours.

Let Your hand hold me
While I am still young.
Let me pass through every trial
And come to full age.

My life on earth
Today I entrust to You,
And when I have died
Let me dwell there in heaven.

You, the Eternal,
Thus I sing to You,
For Your glory is great,
Beyond all praising.

140.titleEnglish: All things bright and all things great
140.lyricsEnglish:
All things bright and all things great,
Things of wisdom and of righteousness,
Things great and things small,
All of them were made by God.

And the words that are secret,
What we think and what we say,
When we hide them, He who knows
Sees all that is hidden.

People here and people far away,
The simple and the wise,
All the living children of Adam
Are kept by Jesus the Lord.

The rich and the poor,
People of this place and those from Europe,
Children of servants and children of chiefs,
All are equal before Jesus.

On earth there is no child of man
Whom God Almighty does not love.
All who have a humble spirit,
Who hear Him, believe.

So let us thank the God of grace.
We the poor had wandered and were lost.
Let us thank Him: He truly saves
All who believe in Jesus the Lord.

141.titleEnglish: Praise the Lord! ye heavens, adore Him

142.lyricsEnglish:
When morning gilds the skies,
My heart awaking cries,
May Jesus Christ be praised!
Alike at work and prayer,
To Jesus I repair;
May Jesus Christ be praised!

When sleep her balm denies,
My silent spirit sighs,
May Jesus Christ be praised!
When evil thoughts molest,
With this I shield my breast,
May Jesus Christ be praised!

The night becomes as day
When from the heart we say,
May Jesus Christ be praised!
The powers of darkness fear
When this sweet chant they hear,
May Jesus Christ be praised!

Be this, while life is mine,
My canticle divine,
May Jesus Christ be praised!
Be this the eternal song
Through all the ages long,
May Jesus Christ be praised!

143.titleEnglish: All the earth, to its farthest bounds
143.lyricsEnglish:
All the earth, to its farthest bounds,
All the heaven,
Praise the Lord;
Exalt Him.
Let Him be praised,
People and creatures.
All the earth, to its farthest bounds,
Praise Him.

All the earth, to its farthest bounds,
Worship Him.
Sing the psalms;
Let wisdom sing.
Above all things
Let the heart sing.
All the earth, to its farthest bounds,
Worship Him.

144.lyricsEnglish:
You, God who never ends,
Who rules the nations,
And we, all people,
Exalt You.
We lift our voice
As we give ourselves to You.
Let us come to You today,
Body and spirit.

We call all of you
On this day,
All you Christians,
Praise Him.
Let us sing with joy
For Your blessings.
So let us rejoice
Even if there is sorrow.

Let us all be one
In serving You.
Jesus prayed for us
That we might be one,
All of us His Church,
Beloved children.
So let us love one another
As He has loved us.

Rise and sing;
Praise the Father,
And as we rejoice
With very great joy,
Sing to Jesus
Who saved us.
Let us live in hope
Until we reach heaven.

145.titleEnglish: You alone are eternal, full of wisdom

146.lyricsEnglish:
O worship the King all-glorious above;
O gratefully sing His power and His love:
Our Shield and Defender, the Ancient of Days,
Pavilioned in splendour, and girded with praise.

O tell of His might, O sing of His grace,
Whose robe is the light, whose canopy space;
His chariots of wrath the deep thunder-clouds form,
And dark is His path on the wings of the storm.

The earth, with its store of wonders untold,
Almighty, Thy power hath founded of old,
Hath stablished it fast by a changeless decree,
And round it hath cast, like a mantle, the sea.

Frail children of dust, and feeble as frail,
In Thee do we trust, nor find Thee to fail;
Thy mercies, how tender, how firm to the end,
Our Maker, Defender, Redeemer, and Friend.

147.titleEnglish: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
147.lyricsEnglish:
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation;
O my soul, praise Him, for He is thy health and salvation:
All ye who hear,
Now to His temple draw near,
Joining in glad adoration.

Praise to the Lord, who o'er all things so wondrously reigneth,
Shelters thee under His wings, yea, so gently sustaineth:
Hast thou not seen
How thy entreaties have been
Granted in what He ordaineth?

Praise to the Lord, who doth prosper thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and mercy here daily attend thee:
Ponder anew
What the Almighty can do,
If to the end He befriend thee.

Praise to the Lord! O let all that is in me adore Him!
All that hath life and breath, come now with praises before Him!
Let the Amen
Sound from His people again:
Gladly for aye we adore Him.

148.lyricsEnglish:
Praise Him,
You in the heights,
And the cherubim,
For His creating.
Heavens, praise
Him who made you;
Bow before Him
In His greatness.

Praise Him,
You on the earth;
Strike the harp,
You His chosen.
Praise Him for all
The gifts of His grace;
Praise Him who gave you
A song to sing.

Praise Him,
You instruments
Of every kind
Of voice.
Strike the harp loudly
For His glory,
All you who shout,
Give Him praise.

Praise Him
And give thanks
In every age;
Praise Him.
He who loved us greatly
And redeemed us,
Let Him be praised
Through all ages.

149.lyricsEnglish:
Bright the vision that delighted
Once the sight of Judah's seer;
Sweet the countless tongues united
To entrance the prophet's ear.

Round the Lord in glory seated
Cherubim and seraphim
Filled His temple, and repeated
Each to each the alternate hymn:

"Lord, Thy glory fills the heaven;
Earth is with its fullness stored;
Unto Thee be glory given,
Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord."

Heaven is still with glory ringing,
Earth takes up the angels' cry,
"Holy, Holy, Holy," singing,
"Lord of hosts, the Lord most high."

150.lyricsEnglish:
We thank You, our Father,
Who have kept us by Your grace
Through the hours of daylight
And in our work.
Keep us, O Creator,
In the darkness of this night.

We worship You alone,
Praising Your name.
Your blessings are many,
Given to us in Your mercy,
Though we are not worthy.
That is why we thank You greatly.

But above all things
We thank You for Your love,
For Your Son Jesus,
Who died upon the tree
For us sinners.
We thank You greatly, Father.

151.lyricsEnglish:
Sing to the Lord,
Sing with joy.
Come, come and sing,
Sing to Him with joy,
Songs and psalms.

Our King, the Lord,
He alone is God.
The peaks of the hills have come,
And the sea, He made it:
Our Saviour.

We are all His offspring,
Our Creator.
Come, come and sing,
Sing to God,
Our Saviour.

153.lyricsEnglish:
Hallelujah! Give thanks
To Jesus, our Lord.
Hallelujah! He is King,
He alone is Conqueror.
Many who went before us
Through death
Exalt the Lord
Who has redeemed us all.

Hallelujah! He is our Father;
We are not forsaken.
Always He is with
All who believe in Him.
When He was taken into heaven
With glory in the cloud,
He truly promised
To be with us.

He draws us near and calls us
To feast with Him.
He feeds us, the weak,
With bread from heaven,
That He may give us strength
Which shall not fail
Against every snare of the enemy
And every trial.

Let us praise Jesus
Who came into our land,
Who put on a body
And took our humanity.
He is our advocate;
He alone is Redeemer.
He is praised, He is Lord,
The King who never ends.

157.titleEnglish: Now thank we all our God
157.lyricsEnglish:
Now thank we all our God,
With heart and hands and voices,
Who wondrous things hath done,
In whom His world rejoices;
Who from our mother's arms
Hath blessed us on our way
With countless gifts of love,
And still is ours today.

O may this bounteous God
Through all our life be near us,
With ever joyful hearts
And blessed peace to cheer us;
And keep us in His grace,
And guide us when perplexed,
And free us from all ills
In this world and the next.

All praise and thanks to God
The Father now be given,
The Son, and Him who reigns
With them in highest heaven,
The one eternal God,
Whom earth and heaven adore;
For thus it was, is now,
And shall be evermore.

159.lyricsEnglish:
Before Jesus the saved ones,
A great company, stand.
They sing: He who washed us, He alone,
Be given glory all our days.

What washed those who had sin?
Jesus washed them with His blood, like this.
We sing: He who washed us, He alone,
Be given glory all our days.

That is why they look like the holy;
That is why so many sing together.
You, Jesus, alone made us holy.
Be given glory all our days.

They were rebels, but now
They are servants of Jesus who serve Him.
They sing: He who washed us, He alone,
Be given glory all our days.

Jesus, we all would have perished;
You loved us even when we were sinners,
And You had mercy and made us holy.
Be given glory all our days.

Friends, with joy let us sing to Him,
That others may sing as well.
You, Jesus, alone made us holy.
Be given glory all our days.

166.titleEnglish: I've found a Friend, O such a Friend
166.lyricsEnglish:
I've found a Friend, O such a Friend!
He loved me ere I knew Him;
He drew me with the cords of love,
And thus He bound me to Him.
And round my heart still closely twine
Those ties which nought can sever,
For I am His, and He is mine,
For ever and for ever.

I've found a Friend, O such a Friend!
He bled, He died to save me;
And not alone the gift of life,
But His own self He gave me.
Nought that I have my own I call,
I hold it for the Giver;
My heart, my strength, my life, my all,
Are His, and His for ever.

I've found a Friend, O such a Friend!
All power to Him is given,
To guard me on my onward course,
And bring me safe to heaven.
The eternal glories gleam afar,
To nerve my faint endeavour;
So now to watch, to work, to war,
And then to rest for ever.

168.titleEnglish: Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
168.lyricsEnglish:
Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
Does his successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
Till moons shall wax and wane no more.

To Him shall endless prayer be made,
And praises throng to crown His head;
His name like sweet perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.

People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song,
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their early blessings on His name.

Blessings abound where'er He reigns;
The prisoner leaps to lose his chains,
The weary find eternal rest,
And all the sons of want are blest.

Let every creature rise and bring
Peculiar honours to our King;
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth repeat the loud Amen.

169.titleEnglish: There is a name I love to hear
169.lyricsEnglish:
There is a name I love to hear,
I love to sing its worth;
It sounds like music in my ear,
The sweetest name on earth.

O how I love Jesus,
O how I love Jesus,
O how I love Jesus,
Because He first loved me.

It tells me of a Saviour's love,
Who died to set me free;
It tells me of His precious blood,
The sinner's perfect plea.

It tells of One whose loving heart
Can feel my deepest woe;
Who in each sorrow bears a part
That none can bear below.

172.titleEnglish: O the deep, deep love of Jesus
172.lyricsEnglish:
O the deep, deep love of Jesus,
Vast, unmeasured, boundless, free;
Rolling as a mighty ocean
In its fulness over me.
Underneath me, all around me,
Is the current of Thy love;
Leading onward, leading homeward,
To my glorious rest above.

O the deep, deep love of Jesus,
Spread His praise from shore to shore;
How He loveth, ever loveth,
Changeth never, nevermore;
How He watches o'er His loved ones,
Died to call them all His own;
How for them He intercedeth,
Watcheth o'er them from the throne.

O the deep, deep love of Jesus,
Love of every love the best;
'Tis an ocean vast of blessing,
'Tis a haven sweet of rest.
O the deep, deep love of Jesus,
'Tis a heaven of heavens to me;
And it lifts me up to glory,
For it lifts me up to Thee.

178.titleEnglish: I lay my sins on Jesus
178.lyricsEnglish:
